title: Tak and Cards
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

Tak has $N$ cards. On the $i$-th $(1 \leq i \leq N)$ card is written an integer $x_i$. He is selecting one or more cards from these $N$ cards, so that the average of the integers written on the selected cards is exactly $A$. In how many ways can he make his selection?

## Constraints

- $1 \leq N \leq 50$
- $1 \leq A \leq 50$
- $1 \leq x_i \leq 50$
- $N,\,A,\,x_i$ are integers.

## Partial Score

- $200$ points will be awarded for passing the test set satisfying $1 \leq N \leq 16$.

## Input

The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N A
x_1 x_2 ... x_N
```

## Output

Print the number of ways to select cards such that the average of the written integers is exactly $A$.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

Tak 有 $N$ 张卡片。第 $i$ 张 $(1 \leq i \leq N)$ 卡片上写着一个整数 $x_i$。他要从这 $N$ 张卡片中选择一张或多张，使所选卡片上整数的平均值恰好为 $A$。他有多少种选择方式？

## 约束条件

- $1 \leq N \leq 50$
- $1 \leq A \leq 50$
- $1 \leq x_i \leq 50$
- $N,\,A,\,x_i$ 均为整数。

## 部分分

- 通过满足 $1 \leq N \leq 16$ 的测试集，可获得 $200$ 分。

## 输入格式

输入通过标准输入给出，格式如下：

```
N A
x_1 x_2 ... x_N
```

## 输出格式

输出选择卡片的方式数，使所选卡片上整数的平均值恰好为 $A$。

samples.note:
- The following are the $5$ ways to select cards such that the average is $8$:
- Select the $3$-rd card.
  - Select the $1$-st and $2$-nd cards.
  - Select the $1$-st and $4$-th cards.
  - Select the $1$-st, $2$-nd and $3$-rd cards.
  - Select the $1$-st, $3$-rd and $4$-th cards.
- The answer may not fit into a $32$-bit integer.
